pairedFieldsApplied.sourceEnglish: Rain already follows lines across the land. The sun already warms some places more than others. Wind already finds gaps and ridges. Cold air already settles in hollows.

segments.sourceEnglish: Rain already follows lines across the land.
segments.text: Pula e se e latela mela ho pholletsa le land.

segments.sourceEnglish: The sun already warms some places more than others.
segments.text: Letsatsi le se le futhumatsa libaka tse ling ho feta tse ling.
Moya o batang o se o bokellana ka

pairedFieldsApplied.target: Pula e se e latela mela ho pholletsa le land. Letsatsi le se le futhumatsa libaka tse ling ho feta tse ling. Moya o se o fumana gaps and ridges. Moya o batang o se o bokellana ka hollows.
pairedFieldsApplied.independentReason: Sesotho `moya` is supported as “wind” in the South African Multilingual Natural Sciences & Technology dictionary (SADiLaR, PDF p.243); `Moya o se o` preserves the repeated already-aspect. Land is explicitly retained in English; gaps/ridges/hollows remain exact English. Rain and sun comparative/source ordering preserved.

pairedFieldsApplied.sourceEnglish: The picture shows rain moving downhill. Follow where it speeds up, spreads, sinks, gathers, and leaves the land.

segments.text: , bokellanang, le moo e tlohang land.

pairedFieldsApplied.target: Setšoantšo se bontša pula moving downhill. Latela moo e potlakang, hasanang, sinks, bokellanang, le moo e tlohang land.
pairedFieldsApplied.independentReason: Corrected exact-English `moving downhill` hold removes the prior unsupported valley destination. Speeds up, spreads, exact `sinks`, gathers, and leaves land remain in source order; no decrease or constructed route is added.

pairedFieldsApplied.sourceEnglish: The picture shows rain moving downhill. Follow where it speeds up, spreads, sinks, gathers, and leaves the land.

segments.sourceEnglish: The picture shows rain moving downhill.
segments.text: Tshifanyiso tshi sumbedza mvula i tshi khou tsela nga fhasi.
, ya kuvhangana, na hune ya bva hone kha land.

pairedFieldsApplied.target: Tshifanyiso tshi sumbedza mvula i tshi khou tsela nga fhasi. Tevhelani hune ya speeds up, ya phaḓalala, sinks, ya kuvhangana, na hune ya bva hone kha land.
pairedFieldsApplied.independentReason: `ya ya nga luvhilo` does not clearly express an increase in speed. Hold the exact comparative motion phrase `speeds up,`; retain the remaining source-ordered motions, including the existing exact `sinks` hold.

pairedFieldsApplied.independentReason: The source repeats “already” for rain, sun, wind and cold air. Candidate has `se` in the sun/wind clauses but omits it for rain and cold air. Add the same already marker to those two clauses; preserve source order and all exact landform holds.

pairedFieldsApplied.independentReason: Rain direction is localized as moving downhill, without naming a valley or adding a route. All five motion steps retain their source order; `sinks` remains exact English and no decrease is introduced.
